verdict.rationale: The Drive API's permissions resource lets developers programmatically create and revoke sharing settings (type: user/group/domain/anyone, and roles like reader/writer) [google-drive-docs-7][google-drive-docs-25], satisfying the 'visibility' and revocation part of the story. However, there is no evidence of API support for password-protected links or expiry settings on shared links — Google Drive's sharing model in the docs only covers role/type-based permissions, not password or expiration.  missing for 10: password-protected link support via API, link expiry settings via API, any documentation or example showing these fields on the permissions resource.
